selection: Diagnostic only. Preserve all calibrated, control and durability freezes; no replacement of the point estimates or test-specific correction.
method: Centered fixed-design Rademacher block-wild perturbation of the composite residual, followed by full nonlinear constrained least squares using the shared physical model.
centered_residual: r_star(theta) = r(theta) - r(theta_hat) + B(theta_hat) * block_signs; net-energy row uses the signed sum of time-window residual contributions.
dependence: Same sign for all response channels in the same time block and trip. Different trips have separate blocks. Original time gaps, covariates, initial SOC, scaling and model structure held fixed.
interval: 2.5th and 97.5th percentiles of successful finite nonlinear refits; conditional descriptive ranges, not certified population confidence coverage. Report failed fits, boundary masses, half-sample quantile stability and multistart audits.
bounds: Use original five-parameter engineering bounds unchanged; bounded distribution cannot establish physical correctness or repair structural mismatch.
start: Bound-scaled local-linear warm start projected strictly inside the original bounds; fall back to frozen estimate if plant infeasible.
excitation: Time-weighted speed coverage and ideal road-load power columns mg*v and rho*A*v^3/2. Also inspect the actual frozen composite-residual Jacobian after projecting out Rref/Q/OCV nuisance directions. These are diagnostics, not measured road-force identification.
failure_policy: Keep every requested replicate and optimizer status. Do not silently resample failures or increase the declared budget after seeing outcomes. Resume only with identical protocol and code fingerprints.
limits: Only two training trips, with high SOC; no independent population coverage claim.
Composite residuals need not represent a coherent physical pseudo-trip; energy and window contributions remain algebraically consistent.
Fixed inputs, assumed temperatures, engineering bounds and structural OCV/thermal mismatch are not resampled.
No finite-sample coverage guarantee at a parameter bound or across regenerative switching events.
The secondary 50-draw block lengths are coarse sensitivity diagnostics; the primary 200-draw tails also have Monte Carlo error.
